# Brunswick Companies

> > Brunswick Companies provides comprehensive insurance and surety bond solutions including commercial insurance, professional liability, court bonds, and SBA-backed surety programs.

Brunswick Companies specializes in business insurance, professional liability coverage for attorneys and accountants, and surety bonds for contractors and legal proceedings. They offer specialized programs including the SBA Surety Bond Guarantee Program, Commercial Package Policies (CPP), and cyber liability protection for professional service firms.

## Key Topics

- Surety Bonds
- SBA Surety Bond Guarantee Program
- Commercial Package Policy (CPP)
- Professional Liability Insurance
- Court Bonds (Appeal, Replevin, Injunction)
- Cyber Liability Insurance
- Risk Management
- Contractor License Bonds
- Attorney Malpractice Insurance
- Fidelity & Dishonesty Bonds
- Bad Credit Bond Solutions
- Irrevocable Letter of Credit (ILOC)
- Self-Insured Retention (SIR)
- Data Breach Protection
- Builders Risk Insurance
